reviews.t: I wouldn’t advice using if you work at the hospital
reviews.x: It’s comforable to wear; however, I used this at the hospital using an N95, goggles & additional disposable mask but it kept slipping off (the n95 elastic strings is too tight & it pushes the cap down). I couldnt figure out the best way to position the buttons either. I wouldnt suggest using for hospital use. But if you plan on using it thats not hospital related I would say its ok. Or make sure to wear bobby pins to hold it down.
Very thin fabric & button came off when worn the first time.

I liked the idea of using a bouffant to cover my hair, as I currently use surgical caps and wanted an easy on-easy off option.  I expected the material to be heavier in weight, since I have thick long hair and like to tie it up.  However....it's thin like pantyhose or tights and doesn't support my hair's weight the way I need it to.  It looks like I'm wearing a wave cap; nothing that looks remotely professional to wear outside.  I'm disappointed, tbh.

reviews.t: Good to wear when running errands
reviews.x: Disappointing. The packaging was horrible! Sticky white mess every where! Anthrax Alert! The caps look cheap. It's basically  a du-rag with elastic in the back. I would dare wear to work. But to the grocery store yes. I just expected something I could get a way with a work. This is not that

I'm in LOVE with these!! They are lightweight to help keep you cool. The way these are designed makes it super easy to put on. And it allows for long hair or ponytails with its little pouch type back. And it holds my hair in!!! No more hair caught in gown ties or in the velcro!!

So, I work in nursing and decided that I would give these a try since I like to keep my hair covered at work. I have long hair so purchased these since they are said for long hair. Well, let's start with the buttons. The placement of the buttons is dumb.  Directly over the ears. So, even though I didn't intend to use them at work, since I use a K95, they pushed down on top of my ears and caused a lot of pain. I ended up removing the buttons immediately. Useless. I bought this item for dual purposes. First to cover my head because I have short hair. Second to keep mask loops off my ears. I gave it four stars because it does what I need. There are some issues with this product. The material is breathable but has polyester look & feel. This product seems to be intended for people with lots of hair. If you have  short hair, there will be lots of slack. I had to wear a scarf underneath to have a secure fit & feel to it.

I have to wear my hair up in a bun whenever I work so I like that these caps easily fit over my hair. It stays put and I love the buttons on the side to keep the mask loops off my ears. I also wear an N95 (or similar) under a surgical mask while in patient care. I've never had the straps slide down or up on me either. I wash them in a mesh laundry bag so the buttons dont get caught on other things in the wash. My only complaint is that the material is a little too thin.

These have been a life saver. I typically wear hair coverings when I go out and about to protect my hair. The colors are really nice, and the buttons help with the comfort level when wearing masks as well. Would definitely recommend for those who have to wear masks for extended periods of time.
These caps fit as expected. My daughter wears them to work and I thought they were awesome…and they are.
I love these, they are stretchy and not too hot.

The material isn’t good. It’s too big, it does not hold the face mask as pictured. When I put this item on the buttons on each side which is supposed to hold the face mask is position really low. Therefore the mask hangs over my mouth and not my nose. In other words this is just a head cover, the mask have to be worn behind the ear as normal. Overall I’m not happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: Material stretches out and doesn’t shrink back
reviews.x: These are really cute and soft but after wearing for a few weeks the headband area stretches out permanently and the hat ends up sliding back on the hairline. After washing the fabric stays stretched out.
This cap is not what I expected 😒.  Very thin,and I found it to be a little awkward.  It  does hold the face mask as described.  I just wished it was a little heavier or thicker.
I liked them enough to order additional ones in different colors. Very comfortable and looks good. My head feels cool in the summer Wisconsin heat.
Thin and lightweight, good for warm temperatures. Only negative is that it bleeds when wet, so I have to wash it separately.

reviews.t: They really don’t look very nice
reviews.x: They don’t look professional—more like a sleep cap
Nice colors.  Look nice.  Button for mask is good.

reviews.t: Description is pretty much spot on👍
reviews.x: My hair is cut just below the jaw line but I have a tendency to shed.. therefore I want something whenever I’m prepping in my kitchen. These are great. Very soft and easy to put on and cover everything. Although it does have elastic in the back it does not have any additional option to tighten. One was just a tad bit looser than the other ones but still worked for me. The only reason for the 4 stars and not 5 was the inability to adjust. Multiple uses to wear these especially during cleaning and

They vaccum sealed these tiny hats (basically saving them no space).  It made the hats permanently wrinkled.  It has made them way less desirable to wear.  Also two were tight and one was way too loose.  The two tight ones I stretched a bit and now they fit great.  I wear them around the house and maybe someday the wrinkles will go out but so far no luck with everything I have tried.  I can't wear the middle blue color as it is way too big.  So I really just got two wrinkled hats out of three.

reviews.t: Buttons are not in a good spot
reviews.x: They are very stretchy which isn’t necessarily a good or bad thing but the buttons are in put in place where when you hook your mask on them it creates a pressure on my ears that hurts worse than just wearing the mask on my ears.  They are light weight and don’t make my head hot but I can’t deal with the ear pain.

Very soft and comfortable. I machine washed them and hung them to dry. Thought they were great and I ordered more. Very disappointed that two of them started falling apart, 1 after the second wash and the other after the 3rd. When I received the next set I ordered, one of them was already unraveling.

reviews.t: Save your ears and look good doing it
reviews.x: These little caps are a lifesaver the buttons hold the mask in place so my ears are saved. They're light enough that they're comfortable and I forget I'm even wearing them. And the colors go with just about every pair of Scrubs I have

Material is too thin than expected and even with the elastic band it is still too big. The buttons to supposedly tie the mask in are not positioned properly so the masks end up to be loose on your face. Not worth buying.
I bought this product for work as I work in healthcare and wearing a mask all day gets tiring especially on the ears. The bonnet was way too big for my head and it wouldn’t stay on.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the caps comfortable, lightweight, and easy to wear, with several praising the fit and cooling feel.
The buttons designed to hold mask loops are a common point of praise for keeping straps off the ears, though some reviewers find the button placement awkward or too low.
A recurring complaint is that the fabric is very thin and flimsy, with some expecting a heavier material.
Several reviewers report fit and durability problems, including caps slipping off, being too big, buttons coming off, and the headband stretching out permanently.
Some reviewers find the caps unsuitable for hospital or clinical work, while others say they work well for patient care.
